pathParams.name: id
pathParams.description: The ID of the logical PCI mapping.

params.name: delete
params.description: A list of settings you want to delete.

params.name: description
params.description: Description of the logical PCI device.

params.name: digest
params.description: Prevent changes if current configuration file has a different digest. This can be used to prevent concurrent modifications.

params.name: live-migration-capable
params.description: Marks the device(s) as being able to be live-migrated (Experimental). This needs hardware and driver support to work.

params.name: map
params.description: A list of maps for the cluster nodes.

params.name: mdev
params.description: Marks the device(s) as being capable of providing mediated devices.
